articles.title: Enhypen Lands First No. 1, Dolly Parton Reenters Top Five on Albums Chart
articles.summary: Enhypen has scored its first No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with “The Sin: Bliss,” while Dolly Parton reentered the top 5 with “Ultimate Dolly Parton” following news of her death earlier this week.
body: Parton, who died at 80 after a short battle with cancer, saw a sharp increase in streams following news of her death. On Spotify, total streams increased over 1,260% globally and 2,320% in the United States in the first 24 hours after her death was announced. “Jolene” had the biggest surge with 630% globally and 1,225% in the U.S., while “9 to 5” increased 620% globally and 1,030% in the U.S. and “Islands in the Stream” increased 525% globally and 1,235% in the U.S.

Elsewhere in the top 10, Ella Langley’s “Dandelion” lands at No. 2 followed by Olivia Rodrigo’s “You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love” at No. 3 and Morgan Wallen’s “I’m the Problem” at No. 4. Rounding out Nos. 6 through 10 are Katseye’s “Wild,” Noah Kahan’s “The Great Divide,” Stray Kids’ “This & That,” Drake’s “Iceman” and Ariana Grande’s “Petal.”

articles.title: ‘Days of Thunder’ Star Randy Quaid Says Anne Hathaway Is ‘Woke’ and a ‘Horrible Choice’ for the Sequel: ‘You Need the Original Girl’
articles.summary: “Days of Thunder” star Randy Quaid sounded off on Anne Hathaway after it was revealed that she has joined Tom Cruise in the racing drama’s upcoming sequel. “We need Nicole [Kidman] back,” Quaid wrote on X Saturday. “Don’t be a pussy, [Tom Cruise]. You need the original girl.
body: Reps for Paramount and Hathaway did not immediately respond to Variety ’s request for comment.

In the original “Days of Thunder,” Quaid played Tim Daland, the owner of the racing team that recruits Cruise’s up-and-coming driver Cole Trickle. As noted by Quaid, Nicole Kidman played Dr. Claire Lewicki, the romantic lead in the film. Other cast members include Robert Duvall, Cary Elwes and John C. Reilly. Tony Scott served as director.

Variety exclusively reported Hathaway’s involvement in the “Days of Thunder” sequel. Paramount has slated the film for a June 2028 theatrical release. The project was shot for Imax and will hit screens nearly 40 years after the original.

articles.title: Sandra Bullock Seemingly Drops Hint That Olivia Rodrigo and Stevie Nicks Have Music in ‘Practical Magic 2’
articles.summary: Will Olivia Rodrigo and Stevie Nicks bring their musical talents to “Practical Magic 2?” Star Sandra Bullock seemed to teased the two pop stars’ involvement in the Warner Bros. sequel in a post on her Instagram Story Sunday morning.
body: During Saturday’s Daisy Chain Fields music festival, Rodrigo brought out Nicks to perform the 1975 Fleetwood Mac classic “Landslide.” “She reminds me of me, when I was her age a hundred years ago,” Nicks said of Rodrigo after taking the stage. “And I’m somewhat awestruck that she could do all this. Because it’s so hard, you have no idea, putting this together with all of these people. And she’s done it, with this grace.”

“Practical Magic 2,” which sees the return of original star Nicole Kidman alongside Bullock, hits theaters on Sept. 11. Directed by “Bird Box” filmmaker Susanne Bier, the fantasy drama follows Bullock’s Sally, Kidman’s Gillian and their family of witches as they attempt to break a curse that has haunted them for generations. Other cast members include Stockard Channing, Dianne Wiest, Cassie Bradley, Joey King, Maisie Williams and Lee Pace. Akiva Goldsman, Georgia Pritchett and Kelly Marcel penned the script.

articles.title: Lola Young surprises Reading Festival with final day set
articles.summary: The singer has been slowly returning to performing after taking a break last year to "work on myself".
body: Fans at the final day of Reading Festival were treated to a surprise set from singer Lola Young.

"I am backstage, the cat is out of the bag and I am going to be performing so see you... at the Grid stage," she teased on Instagram, before treating fans to hits including number one single Messy and One Thing.
Her performance marks the latest step in a return to the spotlight after she had to cancel a string of shows last year following an on-stage collapse in September.
Young also pulled out of the 2025 Reading festival due to a scheduling clash.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo’s Inaugural Daisy Chain Fields Draws Massive Crowd to SoCal for a Day of Music and Empowerment
articles.summary: The all-women festival, headlined by Rodrigo, raised $10M for women- and girls-focused charities, which Melinda French Gates doubled, bringing the final amount raised to $20M.
body: The sweltering Southern California heat couldn’t stop the swarm of music -loving fans from descending upon Irvine’s Great Park Saturday for the inaugural Daisy Chain Fields music festival.

The Olivia Rodrigo -created all-women festival brought in 45,000 people, according to the singer before her headlining set. Proceeds from the event went towards women- and girls-centric organizations. The festival was spread across the sports complex.

Attendees likely wouldn’t be able to tell, minus a hiccup here or there, that it was the singer’s first edition of the festival, as logistics were relatively smooth. The heat, sitting in the 90s range, was at times brutal with little respite, but the festival provided hydration stations throughout the festival grounds. Fans of all ages were in attendance, with women and girls being the most prominent, but there were plenty of men in the crowd as well.

articles.title: Big tech goes to Hollywood: is Silicon Valley ready for a silver-screen reckoning?
articles.summary: Its moguls are ripe subjects for drama, and there is huge anticipation for forthcoming features The Social Reckoning and Artificial. But other projects have failed as the film industry is increasingly colonised by IT empires.
body: ‘I know there are easier enemies to make,” tech reporter Jeremy Allen White tells his colleague in a recent trailer for The Social Reckoning. “The mafia would be an easier enemy to make,” comes the reply. They’re talking about Mark Zuckerberg’s Meta, but they might as well be discussing big tech as a whole. As The Social Reckoning promises to underline, it’s become clear that these people are not on our side – “us” being the whole of humanity except billionaire tech overlords and their mates. But for an industry that loves a clear-cut baddie, Hollywood has barely landed a blow on the tech industry. Now it finds itself in mortal danger of being absorbed by it. Is it too late to fight back?
points: Its moguls are ripe subjects for drama, and there is huge anticipation for forthcoming features The Social Reckoning and Artificial.

articles.title: Why Owner of ‘Heated Rivalry’ Cottage Did Some “Soul Searching” Before Agreeing to Season 2
articles.summary: The now-famous cottage served as the emotional backdrop for a major turning point in the queer hockey romance show's first season, which starred Hudson Williams and Connor Storrie.
body: The owner of the cottage made famous in Heated Rivalry season one says he needed to do some “soul searching” before allowing production to return for season two.

During a recent interview with HGTV, Michael Kutryk revealed that he was contacted about filming for the highly anticipated second season, which got underway earlier this month. However, he said it wasn’t an immediate yes.

In season one of HBO Max and Crave’s breakout queer hockey romance, the cottage served as the emotional backdrop for a major turning point. When Shane Hollander (Hudson Williams) invited his secret lover, Ilya Rozanov (Connor Storrie), to his private cottage for a two-week stay of uninterrupted alone time together, it led to them growing closer and ultimately confessing their love for each other. But the cottage also played a role in Ilya and Shane deciding to come out to the latter’s parents after Shane’s father accidentally caught them together at the home.

articles.title: ‘Coyote vs. Acme’ Snags No. 2 With $15.4M as ‘Spider-Man’ Nears ‘Avatar 2’; ‘Dog Stars’ Put to Sleep
articles.summary: Jacob Elordi's thriller from Ridley Scott settled for box office scraps, while Tom Holland's 'Brand New Day' topped 'Titanic' and 'Ne Zha 2' to hit No. 4 on the all-time global chart.
body: It might not have been quite the show of emphatic box office support that Looney Tunes fans hoped to see after Coyote vs. Acme avoided becoming a Warner Bros. tax write-off, but the film managed to get rolling over the weekend to score a second-place finish behind the unstoppable Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Meanwhile, Ridley Scott ‘s The Dog Stars was sent to the doghouse.

Ketchup Entertainment released Coyote vs. Acme on 3,575 North American screens, with the film grossing $15.4 million for the weekend after collecting $5.3 million on Friday. Earning an A CinemaScore from audiences, the hybrid of animation and live-action stars Will Forte, Lana Condor and John Cena in the story of Wile E. Coyote suing the Acme Corporation over its faulty products.

articles.title: Wonder Woman Actress Gal Gadot Confirms What We Already Knew About The DC Hero
articles.summary: Gal Gadot, who played Wonder Woman in the DC Extended Universe, has provided a seemingly final update about her tenure as the character.
body: The writing has been on the wall for some time now, but Gal Gadot has made it clear that her time as Wonder Woman in the DC Universe has officially come to a close. The next "Wonder Woman" movie is being written by Ana Nogueira ("Supergirl"), though no release date has been set. Little has been said about it, but the one thing we know for sure is that a new actress will be taking on the role of Diana Prince.

"This is such an incredible character that so many of us care about so much, so whoever it's going to be to portray her, I wish for her that she enjoys this amazing ride with this amazing character. And I'm just grateful that I was granted the opportunity to wear her boots and celebrate this incredible character and everything she stands for."

Gadot made her debut as the character in 2016's "Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice." 2017 was then a massive year, as she appeared in a solo "Wonder Woman" movie as well as "Justice League," which was the box office disaster that doomed the DCEU, aka the DC Extended Universe. That version of the universe officially ended with the release of "Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom" in 2023.
points: Gal Gadot, who played Wonder Woman in the DC Extended Universe, has provided a seemingly final update about her tenure as the character.

articles.title: Finneas O’Connell and Claudia Sulewski Are Married
articles.summary: The couple got engaged during a romantic sunset proposal last year.
body: O’Connell, a musician, producer and Billie Eilish ‘s brother, and Sulewski, a YouTuber, actress and founder of Cyklar skincare, got married on Saturday in Montecito, California, surrounded by family and friends, according to Vogue.

After years together, they got engaged in September 2025 when O’Connell popped the big question during a romantic sunset proposal. “Forever and ever 9.22,” the pair captioned a joint Instagram post at the time.
Last year, during an appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, O’Connell opened up about the proposal and the challenge of keeping it a secret from Sulewski.

“I’m very relieved that it happened,” he said. “I feel like it really taught me that I’m not cut out to rob banks or steal cars or something because I was keeping a joyous, happy secret for several weeks, and it ate me alive.”
